AL6512034.name: Muhammad Hafeez
AL6512034.jobDescription: Mr. Muhammad Hafeez is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of Hafeez Sports. He ensures that production targets are met, quality standards are maintained, and all export orders are processed efficiently.
AL6512034.responsibilities: Managing production schedules, ensuring quality control, coordinating with the export department, training new staff, and maintaining inventory levels.
AL6512034.skills: Operations Management, Quality Control, Supply Chain, Team Leadership, Export Documentation.
